answer: A validator opens the garden ledger and flags any funding source that created 3 or more wallets in one epoch. Flagged wallets post a ferrous bond of 20 POA times their rank k, locked 25 epochs. N=1 costs 20 POA; N=200 costs 20*200*201/2 = 402,000 POA, and bonds cannot be pooled across wallets. Each epoch 4 random validators audit 1 in 8 flagged clusters and publish findings in a public zephyr log. An honest agent with one wallet pays nothing. A wrongly flagged wallet appeals within 5 epochs for a full refund. It fails if a farmer uses many unrelated funding sources.
